sentences.s: Television is one of the means by which these feelings are created and conveyed—and perhaps never before has it served so much to connect different peoples and nations as in the recent events in Europe.

trunk.主干翻译: 电视是引发和传递这些感受的手段之一。

components.原文: by which these feelings are created and conveyed
components.中文翻译: 引发和传递这些感受的
components.说明: 介词 by 提前的定语从句，修饰 means；从句为被动语态，译成主动的“……的”字结构前置。

components.原文: and perhaps never before has it served so much to connect different peoples and nations as in the recent events in Europe
components.中文翻译: 在欧洲近来发生的事件中，它把不同的民族和国家连在一起，其作用之大，前所未有
components.说明: 破折号连接的并列分句，否定副词 never before 置于句首引起部分倒装（has it served）。

components.原文: to connect different peoples and nations
components.中文翻译: 把不同的民族和国家连在一起
components.说明: 不定式作目的状语，说明电视所发挥作用的指向。

components.原文: as in the recent events in Europe
components.中文翻译: 像在欧洲近来发生的事件中那样
components.说明: so much...as... 比较结构，对比过去与现在，凸显作用之大前所未有。

sentences.zh: 电视是引发和传递这些感受的手段之一——在欧洲近来发生的事件中，它把不同的民族和国家连在一起，其作用之大，前所未有。

sentences.s: In Europe, as elsewhere, multi-media groups have been increasingly successful; groups which bring together television, radio, newspapers, magazines and publishing houses that work in relation to one another.

trunk.主干翻译: 多媒体集团越来越成功。

components.原文: In Europe
components.中文翻译: 在欧洲
components.说明: 介词短语作地点状语。

components.原文: as elsewhere
components.中文翻译: 像在其他地方一样
components.说明: as 引导的比较状语，将欧洲与别处类比。

components.原文: groups which bring together television, radio, newspapers, magazines and publishing houses that work in relation to one another
components.中文翻译: 这些集团将相关的电视、广播、报纸、杂志和出版社组合在一起
components.说明: 分号后的名词短语是 multi-media groups 的同位语，翻译时化作其谓语结构以免头重脚轻。

components.原文: which bring together television, radio, newspapers, magazines and publishing houses that work in relation to one another
components.中文翻译: 将相关的电视、广播、报纸、杂志和出版社组合在一起的
components.说明: which 引导的定语从句，修饰同位语中心词 groups。

components.原文: that work in relation to one another
components.中文翻译: 相互之间关联密切的
components.说明: 内嵌的 that 定语从句，修饰前面列举的各媒体领域，说明它们彼此关联。

sentences.zh: 在欧洲，像在其他地方一样，多媒体集团越来越成功：这些集团将相关的电视、广播、报纸、杂志和出版社组合在一起。

sentences.s: This alone demonstrates that the television business is not an easy world to survive in, a fact underlined by statistics that show that out of eighty European television networks, no less than 50% took a loss in 1989.

trunk.宾语或表语: that the television business is not an easy world to survive in
trunk.主干翻译: 仅这一点就足以表明，要在电视行业里生存下来并非易事。

components.原文: that the television business is not an easy world to survive in
components.中文翻译: 电视行业并非一个容易生存的领域
components.说明: that 引导的宾语从句，作 demonstrates 的宾语。

components.原文: to survive in
components.中文翻译: 生存下来的
components.说明: 不定式作后置定语修饰 world，介词 in 后置。

components.原文: a fact underlined by statistics that show that out of eighty European television networks, no less than 50% took a loss in 1989
components.中文翻译: 这一事实被统计数字所证实，在80家欧洲电视网中，多达一半在1989年亏损
components.说明: 名词短语作前面整个主句内容的同位语（a fact 回指主句所述）。

components.原文: underlined by statistics
components.中文翻译: 被统计数字所凸显的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 fact，体现被动，译时调整为主动“统计数字说明了这一事实”。

components.原文: that show that out of eighty European television networks, no less than 50% took a loss in 1989
components.中文翻译: 表明在80家欧洲电视网中多达一半在1989年亏损的
components.说明: that 引导的定语从句修饰 statistics，因过长且陈述具体事例，翻译时单独成句。

components.原文: that out of eighty European television networks, no less than 50% took a loss in 1989
components.中文翻译: 在80家欧洲电视网中，多达一半在1989年亏损
components.说明: that 引导的宾语从句，作 show 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 这一点就足以表明，要在电视行业里生存下来并非易事，统计数字尤其说明了这一事实，在80家欧洲电视网中，多达一半在1989年亏损。

sentences.s: Creating a ``European identity'' that respects the different cultures and traditions which go to make up the connecting fabric of the Old Continent is no easy task and demands a strategic choice

trunk.主干翻译: 创造出一种“欧洲认同”绝非易事。

components.原文: Creating a ``European identity'' that respects the different cultures and traditions which go to make up the connecting fabric of the Old Continent
components.中文翻译: 要创造出一种尊重不同文化和传统的“欧洲认同”
components.说明: 动名词短语作句子主语，谓语为 is。

components.原文: that respects the different cultures and traditions which go to make up the connecting fabric of the Old Continent
components.中文翻译: 尊重不同文化和传统的
components.说明: that 引导的定语从句，修饰 European identity，点明其实质。

components.原文: which go to make up the connecting fabric of the Old Continent
components.中文翻译: 把欧洲大陆编织成一体的
components.说明: 内嵌的 which 定语从句，修饰 cultures and traditions。

components.原文: and demands a strategic choice
components.中文翻译: 并且需要做出战略性的选择
components.说明: and 连接的并列谓语，与 is 并列共享同一动名词主语。

sentences.zh: 不同的文化和传统把欧洲大陆编织成一体，要创造出一种尊重这些不同文化和传统的“欧洲认同”绝非易事，需要人们做出战略性的选择。

sentences.s: In dealing with a challenge on such a scale, it is no exaggeration to say, ``United we stand, divided we fall''

components.原文: In dealing with a challenge on such a scale
components.中文翻译: 在应付如此规模的挑战时
components.说明: 介词短语（in + 动名词）作时间/条件状语，置于句首。

components.原文: on such a scale
components.中文翻译: 如此规模的
components.说明: 介词短语作后置定语修饰 challenge。

components.原文: to say, ``United we stand, divided we fall''
components.中文翻译: 说“联合，我们就生存；分裂，我们就灭亡”
components.说明: 不定式作真正主语，前面的 it 为形式主语。

components.原文: ``United we stand, divided we fall''
components.中文翻译: 联合，我们就生存；分裂，我们就灭亡
components.说明: 作 say 的引语宾语，两个并列分句含条件含义的省略结构，前置成分表条件。

sentences.zh: 在应付如此规模的挑战时，可以毫不夸张地说，“联合，我们就生存；分裂，我们就灭亡。”
